I saved Ilse's preference in GBrain: Bay 30 is their dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups from 2026-10-14 on. It's a private memory under their name, with the source recorded as their DM. Then I replied in the DM to confirm. They said no other action was needed, so I did nothing else.

GBrain is running with keyword search only, so it only catches exact duplicates. No earlier dock note for them came up when I checked, but a differently worded one could have been missed.
